scope: 1.3.0 written feature introductions (features.html / features-en.html); no guide videos
userDirection: 内容以 1.2.3 为底，加上三项新功能的文字介绍，视频等验收后再补；push 到官网 main，默认入口仍是 1.2.3，不切换。

appearance.schedule.limit.ja: 最大%lld件まで追加できます。
appearance.schedule.limit.en: You can add up to %lld dates.

features.facts: Photo backgrounds only; month/day dates repeat every year; up to 64 dates.

reminder.pending.footer.ja: 選んだ財布に未確認の記録があるときだけ通知します。通知をタップすると、使用中の財布の未確認の記録を開きます。…通知は端末ごとにオンにしてください。
reminder.pending.footer.en: You’ll be notified only when the selected wallets have pending entries. Tap the notification to open pending entries in the current wallet. … Turn on notifications on each device.

features.facts: Notification shows the count only; nothing is sent when there are no pending entries; enablement is per device.

chat.receipt_photo.choose_total.ja: 合計金額を確認して、正しい金額をタップしてください
chat.receipt_photo.choose_total.en: Check the total and tap the correct amount

features.facts: Reads total, date and store name; multi-page document camera for long receipts; candidate totals are tapped to choose; the original image and recognized text are not saved.

terminology: All UI names quoted on the page are the App's existing strings from docs/data/l10n-master.csv; no new UI term or translation was introduced. Japanese copy uses 記録, never 記帳. Marketing sentences are newly written for Kotori and contain no internal mechanism (OCR, models, DataPack).
externalSearch: Not performed: no new terminology beyond the App's existing localized strings.
